status: Confirmed conditional comparison mismatch repaired; one direct-helper gate remains open.

source.change_summary: Replaced two Kotlin-style compareTo translations of (heightDelta - 0.5625) with direct Java heightDelta > 0.5625D predicates.

confirmed_difference_and_fix.original: At both 0.5625 threshold sites the original compares heightDelta directly to the constant with dcmpl; NaN therefore does not take the greater-than branch.
confirmed_difference_and_fix.pre_fix_source: Subtracting 0.5625 first and translating Kotlin Double.compareTo semantics treated a NaN difference as positive.
confirmed_difference_and_fix.post_fix_compiled: Both sites compile as a direct double comparison against 0.5625D, using dcmpl and the same greater-than branch outcome as the original for NaN and finite values.

bytecode_review.other_difference_not_closed: Direct helper g(BlockPos) has an original gate/fallback path not represented in the current source. Its state reachability is unresolved; this experiment did not edit it.

boundary_probe.assertions: Corrected predicate matches dcmpl greater-than semantics on all six fixtures; the previous translation differs for NaN.

nonfatal_output: Fabric Loom reported missing markdown metadata in mod-provided javadoc.

invalidated_attempts.reason: The wrapper was first invoked from the repository root; gradlew.bat is under polinex-src, so no Gradle build ran.
A correctly located build used JAVA_HOME pointing to Java 17; Loom requires Java 25. The unchanged source then built successfully after selecting Temurin 25.0.4.1.

next_slice: Resolve the direct helper g(BlockPos) gate: enumerate state initialization and all writes, then decide whether the original fallback is normally reachable. Do not claim route equivalence before that and a valid-world path test.
